mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS change (1-month) and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS change and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE decline * CPIAUCSL increase) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal is not observed in more than 60% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increase > 50k in a month) signals persistent inflation and accelerates rate hike expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months, the negative return signal from PAYEMS growth >50k is not observed in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units over a 3-month period signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1200 in 3 months but SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 index points for two consecutive months signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105 for two months but SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth >0.5% month-over-month but SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a strong consumer-led economic expansion that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS growth * HOUST growth) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return signal is not observed in more than 60% of interaction events.
